traits.name: Pack Tactics.
traits.text: The kobold has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Dagger.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling.
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
